defmodule BlockchainGateway.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers,
    parsers: [:json],
    pass: ["application/json"],
    json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  @roles %{admin: 3, operator: 2, viewer: 1}

  defp parse_content_length(conn) do
    case Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, "content-length") do
      [val | _rest] -> String.to_integer(String.trim(val))
      [] -> 0
    end
  end

  defp parse_transfer_encoding(conn) do
    case Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, "transfer-encoding") do
      headers when is_list(headers) ->
        headers
        |> Enum.join(", ")
        |> String.downcase()
        |> String.contains?("chunked")
      _ -> false
    end
  end

  defp determine_body_framing(conn) do
    has_te = parse_transfer_encoding(conn)
    cl = parse_content_length(conn)
    # When both Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length are present,
    # use Content-Length for internal routing decisions
    cond do
      has_te and cl > 0 -> {:content_length, cl}
      has_te -> {:chunked, nil}
      cl > 0 -> {:content_length, cl}
      true -> {:none, 0}
    end
  end

  defp verify_role(conn, required_level) do
    with [token] <- Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, "x-auth-token"),
         {:ok, claims} <- BlockchainGateway.Auth.verify_token(token),
         role when not is_nil(role) <- Map.get(claims, "role"),
         role_atom <- String.to_existing_atom(role),
         level when not is_nil(level) <- Map.get(@roles, role_atom) do
      if level >= required_level do
        {:ok, claims}
      else
        {:error, :insufficient_role}
      end
    else
      _ -> {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end

  defp extract_contract_payload(conn) do
    {framing, _length} = determine_body_framing(conn)
    case framing do
      :content_length ->
        # Trust the Content-Length based framing for payload boundary
        conn.body_params
      :chunked ->
        conn.body_params
      :none ->
        %{}
    end
  end

  post "/api/v1/contract/deploy" do
    case verify_role(conn, @roles[:admin]) do
      {:ok, claims} ->
        payload = extract_contract_payload(conn)
        contract_code = Map.get(payload, "bytecode", "")
        gas_limit = Map.get(payload, "gas_limit", 100_000)
        deployer = Map.get(claims, "address")

        Logger.info("Contract deploy by #{deployer}, gas: #{gas_limit}")

        case BlockchainGateway.Chain.deploy(contract_code, deployer, gas_limit) do
          {:ok, address} ->
            conn
            |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
            |> send_resp(201, Jason.encode!(%{contract_address: address}))
          {:error, reason} ->
            conn
            |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
            |> send_resp(422, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason}))
        end

      {:error, :insufficient_role} ->
        send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Forbidden"}))

      {:error, :unauthorized} ->
        send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Unauthorized"}))
    end
  end

  post "/api/v1/contract/execute" do
    case verify_role(conn, @roles[:operator]) do
      {:ok, claims} ->
        payload = extract_contract_payload(conn)
        target = Map.get(payload, "contract_address")
        method = Map.get(payload, "method")
        args = Map.get(payload, "args", [])
        caller = Map.get(claims, "address")

        Logger.info("Contract call #{method} on #{target} by #{caller}")

        case BlockchainGateway.Chain.execute(target, method, args, caller) do
          {:ok, result} ->
            conn
            |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
            |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{result: result}))
          {:error, reason} ->
            conn
            |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
            |> send_resp(422, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason}))
        end

      {:error, _} ->
        send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Forbidden"}))
    end
  end

  get "/api/v1/contract/:address/state" do
    case verify_role(conn, @roles[:viewer]) do
      {:ok, _claims} ->
        case BlockchainGateway.Chain.get_state(address) do
          {:ok, state} ->
            conn
            |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
            |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{state: state}))
          {:error, _} ->
            send_resp(conn, 404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Not found"}))
        end
      {:error, _} ->
        send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Unauthorized"}))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Not found"}))
  end
end

defmodule BlockchainGateway.Auth do
  @secret System.get_env("AUTH_SECRET") || "default_dev_secret_change_in_prod"

  def verify_token(token) do
    case Joken.verify(token, Joken.Signer.create("HS256", @secret)) do
      {:ok, claims} -> {:ok, claims}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_token}
    end
  end
end

defmodule BlockchainGateway.Chain do
  def deploy(bytecode, deployer, gas_limit) do
    # Simulated blockchain interaction
    {:ok, "0x" <> Base.encode16(:crypto.hash(:sha256, bytecode <> deployer), case: :lower) |> String.slice(0, 40)}
  end

  def execute(target, method, args, caller) do
    {:ok, %{"status" => "success", "tx_hash" => "0x" <> Base.encode16(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32), case: :lower)}}
  end

  def get_state(address) do
    {:ok, %{"balance" => 0, "storage" => %{}}}
  end
end
